name: switch-advisor
description: Back at a large Codex conversation after a break? Says whether a new conversation started from a handoff is cheaper than re-sending this one. Local; no model calls.

interface.shortDescription: Cost check when you return to a large conversation
interface.longDescription: When you come back to a large Codex conversation after a break, its prompt cache has often expired, so your next message re-reads the whole conversation at the full input price. Switch advisor compares that with starting a new conversation from a handoff built locally from this one, and holds your prompt back only when switching clearly pays. No model calls.
